description: Return and payment due date (9 months after period end) and estimated penalties: late filing AED 500 a month for 12 months then AED 1,000, late payment 14% a year charged monthly (from 14 Apr 2026), AED 10,000 late registration, waived if the first return is filed within 7 months of the end of the first tax period. Blank filing date = today; blank payment date = filing date.

firstReturnFiled.description: Date the first return was filed, if this is not the first period

lateRegistration.description: Registered for Corporate Tax after the deadline

paymentDate.description: Date the tax was or will be paid, YYYY-MM-DD (default = filingDate)

taxDue.description: Corporate Tax payable for the period, AED (for the late payment penalty)
